title: DeAL: Decoding-time Alignment for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Human evaluation of model responses to adversarial and potentially malicious prompts from the HH-RLHF and HarmfulQ datasets. Annotators assess the fraction of generated utterances deemed 'harmless' versus those that yield to the prompts by generating toxic, dangerous, racist, xenophobic, or religiously intolerant content.
